desc: Parse and formalize: for fixed common sum H, final upper lengths lie in [max(0,H-D_i), min(U_i,H)], cost is sum(U_i+D_i) - N*H, so maximize feasible H.
Derive feasibility condition as H <= U_i + D_j + X|i-j| for all i,j, hence Hmax = min_{i,j}(U_i + D_j + X|i-j|).
Identify O(N) algorithm via prefix minima of D_j - X*j for j<=i and suffix minima of D_j + X*j for j>=i.
Implement the Python program reading stdin and writing stdout, computing Hmax in O(N) with 64-bit arithmetic, then outputting S - N*Hmax.
Validate against all four samples (15, 0, 5999999994, 9460); all public samples passed.
